title: Government-published propaganda books as a cover-up campaign

tellings.quote: and you're going to find all sorts of books on the shelves with lots of truth. But right next to them are the books that we publish full of propaganda. It's a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth.

plain: According to this account, the US government has paid for books full of propaganda about UFOs and placed them on bookshop shelves right next to books that tell the truth, as part of what was called "a multi-billion dollar campaign to cover up the truth." A guest named Brent Friedman says this was told to him by John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, and repeats it to Michels. If true, part of what the public reads on the subject was written to mislead it on purpose.
